scope: Exact authored-design identity audit for IDEA000036, 37, 39, 40, 41. No duplicate_of relation is justified.

bindings.title: Figure labels track process state rather than biography
A repeated complete form codes a class or slot, not a unique member
A repeated diagram whole denotes a component or state key rather than an object
A figure-linked whole selects treatment mode rather than a person or material
A diagram whole marks a return-loop or branch junction

proposed_relations.reason: Both use recurrence/covariance across context, but 36 targets figure labels tracking process/material state versus biography or patient identity; 39 targets diagram wholes tracking shared stage/state versus local owner/object. Units and falsifiers differ.

Both contrast contextual covariance with owner/material alternatives, but 36 asks process/material state versus biography, while 40 asks treatment-mode/procedure position while controlling figure and material. No complete proposition match.

Both test repeated complete forms across visual instances, but 37 predicts class/slot invariance against unique member/ordinal readings; 39 predicts stage/state covariance under owner substitution. Different target units, rivals, and falsifiers.

Both are diagram-topology-adjacent, but 39 tests shared component/state across changing owners; 41 tests return/junction enrichment against terminal/component association. A locus can satisfy both, so neither implies the other.

no_relation_or_duplicate.decision: No relation proposed from current designs; treatment-mode and graph-topology units are too different, though a later visual dossier may find a source-specific link.
No relation proposed; class/slot recurrence and treatment-mode scope share only generic contextual testing.
No relation proposed; figure/process biography and class/slot/member identity are distinct semantic questions.

control_identifiability.general_rule: Independent annotations do not by themselves identify a meaning. If the target context and its rival are perfectly correlated, both readings predict the same observed table.
control_identifiability.IDEA000036: If every apparatus/material state belongs to one biography or patient, state covariance and biography covariance are observationally identical. Require crossed state/person contexts or held owner substitutions.
control_identifiability.IDEA000037: If each class/slot has one member and each member one slot, class-code and unique-member readings are identical. Require repeated class/slot with changing members and repeated members across slots, or an owner-masked held comparison.
control_identifiability.IDEA000039: If stage/state is fixed by local owner, shared-state and owner-specific readings coincide. Require the same stage/state under multiple owners and owners across multiple stages/states.
control_identifiability.IDEA000040: If treatment mode always co-occurs with one figure or material, mode and person/material readings coincide. Require crossed treatment modes for the same owner/material and changing owners/materials within a mode.
control_identifiability.IDEA000041: If every return/junction is one component class or owner, topology and component/owner readings coincide. Require topology-class variation within component/owner and component/owner variation within topology.

source_and_count_policy: All five proposals retain source spans in their own files. Their cited GDT208/GDT209/GDT210/GDT214/GDT793 reports are comparator observations or conditional theories, not independent Voynich label bindings. No proposal uses a renderer-generated count as a semantic endpoint. The small comparator counts (for example, GDT209's two connected vessels and one return-loop vessel) describe inspected source imagery; they do not establish manuscript frequency or meaning.
recommendation: Keep all five raw records. If relation decisions are later appended, use related_not_equivalent only for the four proposed pairs above; do not use duplicate_of. Before any selection, require factorial/crossed endpoint coverage, not merely more independently named covariates.

exact_current_spans.quote:
The q13 apparatus pages most plausibly describe a **medicinal-alchemical
circulation, separation, and staged-transformation system**.  Their human
figures are provisionally better modeled as personified materials or process
states inside an apparatus than as a literal catalogue of bathers.

The result is 0/3. In other words, all apparent address evidence disappears
when the candidate is forbidden from proving itself. The class/slot model
does not predict such a companion fingerprint and survives this test.
